featureFocus: Testing Frameworks, Code Quality Tools, and Development Environment Setup

RSpec.description: The primary testing framework for Ruby applications, used for unit, integration, request, feature, and view specifications. It provides a DSL for writing expressive tests.

interactions.interaction_0: Executes test suites for various application layers.
interactions.interaction_1: Utilizes factories for test data generation.
interactions.interaction_2: Integrates with custom stubbing utilities for isolating microservice interactions.
interactions.interaction_3: Configured via `.rspec` for test patterns and exclusions, including brand-specific tests.
interactions.interaction_4: Works with SimpleCov for code coverage analysis.

SimpleCov.description: A code coverage tool that generates reports for the Ruby codebase. It is configured to filter out non-application files and group source files into logical categories for better readability.

interactions.interaction_0: Analyzes code execution during test runs to determine coverage.
interactions.interaction_1: Filters specific directories (e.g., `bin/`, `db/`, `config/`, `spec/`, `services/`) from coverage reports.
interactions.interaction_2: Groups application code into categories like 'API', 'Business Logic', 'Controllers', 'UI', etc.

RuboCop.description: A static code analyzer and linter for Ruby, enforcing style guidelines and best practices. It is configured with various plugins for Rails, RSpec, Capybara, FactoryBot, and performance checks.

interactions.interaction_0: Analyzes Ruby code against a comprehensive set of rules defined in `.rubocop.yml`.
interactions.interaction_1: Integrates with `rubocop-changed` script to check only modified files.
interactions.interaction_2: Uses plugins like `rubocop-rails`, `rubocop-rspec`, `rubocop-capybara` to provide context-specific linting.

Slim-Lint.description: Linter for Slim template files, ensuring consistent style and preventing common issues like embedded engines. Integrates with RuboCop for Ruby code within Slim.

interactions.interaction_1: Leverages RuboCop for embedded Ruby code linting.

ESLint.description: Static analysis tool for JavaScript and TypeScript code, enforcing best practices and style guidelines. Configured for browser globals and specific project variables.

Stylelint.description: Linter for SCSS files, ensuring consistent styling, idiomatic order, and BEM naming conventions. Configured to be compatible with `ruby-sass` compiler limitations.

Prettier.description: An opinionated code formatter that enforces a consistent style across various file types, including JavaScript, TypeScript, SCSS, YAML, and YML.

bin/setup.description: An idempotent script to set up and update the local development environment, handling gem installation, database preparation, and cleanup.

scripts/check-gem-versions.description: A script to compare gem versions across `Gemfile.lock` files of the main application and microservices, identifying inconsistencies and generating reports.

interactions.interaction_0: Parses `Gemfile.lock` files from the main app and `services/*`.

scripts/rubocop-changed.description: A utility script to run RuboCop only on files that have changed in the Git repository, optimizing code quality checks for incremental development.

interactions.interaction_0: Interacts with Git to identify changed files.
interactions.interaction_1: Executes RuboCop on the identified files.

Gurke.description: The test runner used for executing end-to-end scenarios. It supports both one-off test runs and a DRb server mode for faster iterative testing against running application services.

interactions.interaction_0: Orchestrates the execution of E2E tests defined in `integration/features`.
interactions.interaction_1: Drives a browser via Capybara to simulate user interactions.
interactions.interaction_2: Manages the lifecycle of application services during E2E test execution.
interactions.interaction_3: Configurable for different browsers and debugging modes (headless, slow-motion).

codeBlocks.code:
Gurke.configure do |config|
  if ENV.key? 'CI'
    config.default_retries = 1
    config.flaky_retries = 3
  else
    config.default_retries = 0
    config.flaky_retries = 0
  end

  config.before(:features) do
    # Reload steps for DRb usage
    Dir[Gurke.root.join('steps/**/*.rb')].each {|path| load path }
    Dir[Gurke.root.join('support/ext/**/*.rb')].each {|path| load path }
    Xikolo::Config.reload
  end
end

Capybara.description: A library used by Gurke and RSpec feature specs to simulate user interactions in a web browser. It enables testing of real, interactive UI behavior.

interactions.interaction_0: Drives web browsers (e.g., Chrome, Firefox) to execute user scenarios.
interactions.interaction_1: Used by Gurke for E2E tests and by RSpec for feature tests.
interactions.interaction_2: Supports headless and non-headless modes, and slow-motion for debugging.
interactions.interaction_3: Requires specific environment variables (e.g., `SNAP=1`) for certain browser setups.

interactions.interaction_0: Provides methods like `stub_user_request`, `Stub.service()`, `Stub.request()` to mock HTTP responses from microservices.

Minio.description: A local S3-compatible object storage server that provides a local S3 API, which is a prerequisite for running end-to-end tests.

interactions.interaction_0: Automatically launched and configured by the E2E test setup.
interactions.interaction_1: Serves as a local mock for S3 storage operations during E2E tests.

def self.delete_all
    Xikolo::S3.resource.buckets.each do |bucket|
      # First, delete all objects inside the bucket
      bucket.objects.each(&:delete)

      # Then, delete the empty bucket
      bucket.delete
    end
  end

def self.setup
    uploads = Xikolo::S3.resource.bucket 'xikolo-uploads'
    uploads.create unless uploads.exists?
    uploads.policy.put policy: JSON.dump(YAML.safe_load(<<~POLICY))
      Id: uploads
      Version: '2012-10-17'
      Statement:
        - Sid: content
          Action:
            - 's3:GetObject'
            - 's3:DeleteObject'
          Effect: Allow
          Resource:
            - 'arn:aws:s3:::#{uploads.name}/*'
          Principal: {'AWS': '*'}
